tools.name: preape_check
tools.description: Quick pre-trade risk check for a token on Arc / RadarDEX before buying. Returns GO, CAUTION, AVOID plus one-liner and red flags. Covers observed RadarDEX creator history and LP lock. Does not scan full holders. Use this first.
